thread:
maria (arch): quick sync — proposing a long-running paydown plan: consolidate thin adapters (auth/enrich/format) into an 'ingest-core' slab, schedule 8-week slices with safety gates, and progressively collapse duplicate code paths. I sketched rollout constraints below and wanted objections before we file an RFC.

samir (infra): +1 on centralizing adapters, but latency/regional tail risk? will this increase p99 if we put more on the hotpath?
maria (arch): good call. tradeoffs: single slab increases shared hotpath but reduces duplication and memory churn. mitigations: (1) per-tenant routing to bypass ingest-core for latency-sensitive tenants, (2) staged canary with perf observability, (3) keep adapters logically separate behind interface contracts so we can split again if needed.
alice (eng): can we avoid a big-bang code move? prefer incremental: move one adapter at a time and keep feature flags. also need an ownership matrix so we don't create a new cross-team pager.
maria (arch): yep, incremental only. suggested cadence: 8 weeks per adapter (design + migration + perf run + rollback window). ownership: adapter owner -> migration lead -> sla triage contact. I'll draft a checklist.

ben (platform): idea: introduce a compatibility shim and a feature-flag toggle named ff/ingest-core/<adapter>/v1->v2. sample rollout snippet:```yaml
feature_flag: ff/ingest-core/enrich/v1->v2
rollout: 10% -> 50% -> 100%
metrics: enrich.latency_p50, enrich.latency_p95, enrich.errors
```
we can wire existing rollout infra to auto-revert at threshold. keeps runtime toggles simple.
tara (sre): please include the SLO impact plan. for each adapter move we need a perf smoke: synthetic traffic + 1h extended tail window. tara volunteers to run early canaries and owns the perf runbook. :raised_hands:
deploy-bot: Deployment window scheduled: 2025-05-03 02:00 UTC (canary slot reserved).
maria (arch): thanks @tara — i'll add the perf checklist and the exact revert thresholds. next steps: i will open an RFC draft this week with the ownership matrix and the 8-week slices, and tag migration leads. if no strong objections by EOD tomorrow i'll start the RFC. :slightly_smiling_face:
alice (eng): no objections from me, happy to pick first adapter (auth).
samir (infra): ok from infra, but request: add a KV-cache warmup plan for the auth path so we don't hit cold tails.
maria (arch): noted — KV warmup + cache-prefill step will be in the checklist. thanks all.
